_help.netstorage.profiles: Multiple Akamai NetStorage CP Code profiles. Each profile can have its own host, cp_code, key_name, and key_secret.

sync.add_cp_code_to_cos_path.true: Add CP Code as the first COS directory, for example CP 123456 /uat/a.png -> COS 123456/uat/a.png.
sync.add_cp_code_to_cos_path.false: Do not automatically add CP Code to COS paths. Use cos_dest_prefix per profile if you need custom separation.

sync.strip_redundant_zip_root.true: When extracting xxx.zip, if the ZIP contains top-level xxx/, strip that redundant folder so files land directly under xxx/.
sync.strip_redundant_zip_root.false: Keep ZIP internal paths exactly as-is under the extraction target folder.

sync.strategy.full: Copy all source files every run.
sync.strategy.incremental: Copy only new or changed files based on state. Recommended for scheduled sync.

sync.detect.etag: Use ETag/MD5 when available; fallback to LastModified+Size if missing.

sync.extract_zip_on_ns_to_cos.true: When NS -> COS source file is .zip, upload extracted ZIP entries to COS instead of only uploading the zip file.
sync.extract_zip_on_ns_to_cos.false: Treat .zip files as normal files. COS -> NS never auto-extracts ZIP files.

sync.zip_extract_to_folder.true: Extract xxx.zip to COS prefix xxx/.
sync.zip_extract_to_folder.false: Extract entries directly to the destination prefix.

stability_recommendation.workers: Use 1 worker to reduce concurrent pressure on NetStorage when SSL EOF / connection reset errors occur.
stability_recommendation.skip_failed_dirs: Skip directories that fail listing after retries, and continue syncing other directories.
stability_recommendation.retry: Use more attempts and longer timeout/backoff for unstable NetStorage connections.

sync.prefer_list_metadata.true: Prefer metadata returned by NetStorage directory list and avoid per-file stat requests. Recommended for unstable/large NetStorage trees.
sync.prefer_list_metadata.false: Call NetStorage stat for each file to get per-file metadata.

sync.stat_if_list_metadata_incomplete.true: Only call NetStorage stat when list metadata lacks usable ETag or LastModified+Size.
sync.stat_if_list_metadata_incomplete.false: Never call stat when list metadata is incomplete; use whatever list metadata is available.

_help.sync.failed_dirs_log: Directory list failures are written here so failed dirs can be retried later.
_help.sync.skip_success_log: When true, load success-files.log and skip files that already have an OK src -> dst record. Useful for resume after interruption.
_help.sync.copy_file_attempts: Retry one file copy end-to-end this many times before writing it to failed-files.log.
_help.copy_size_progress: COPY PROGRESS prints total_size, bytes_done, bytes_copied, speed, and ETA based on file sizes from list/stat metadata.
_help.zero_byte_upload: For downloaded size=0, upload an explicit empty bytes payload to COS without adding a trailing slash, preserving file names such as .../Shipping_files/0.

list_cache.read_list_cache=false: Default. Re-list NetStorage directories and then save the result to list_cache_file if write_list_cache=true.
list_cache.read_list_cache=true: Skip NetStorage dir listing and read files/dirs from list_cache_file. Useful when listing is very slow and the tree has already been listed once.
list_cache.write_list_cache=true: After a real NetStorage dir list, save files/dirs to list_cache_file.
list_cache.list_cache_file: Supports placeholders {cp_code}, {source}, {source_hash}, {command}. Default avoids collision across CP codes/source paths.

retry_policy.copy_file_attempts: Total per-file copy attempts. Set to 3: first try + retry attempts up to 3 total attempts, using exponential backoff between attempts.
retry_policy.retry.max_attempts: HTTP request retry attempts. Set to 3, using exponential backoff.
retry_policy.transfer.ns_list_retries: NetStorage directory list retry attempts. Set to 3, using exponential backoff.
